problem: Add CLI commands 'hlx playbook check <rule-ref>' (trigger a check and poll to completion) and 'hlx playbook checks <rule-ref>' (list check history) that communicate with the server's new playbook check API endpoints.

files.why: Main CLI dispatcher. Lines 81-156: switch statement routes commands. A 'playbook' case needs to be added following the pattern of 'goals', 'tickets', etc. (config via configOrHelp, then runPlaybook).

Best reference pattern for a command group with subcommands. Shows goalsUsage(), switch on subcommand, help handling, error catching with parseApiError(). The playbook command group should follow this structure.
Pattern for fetching and displaying a single resource with --json flag support. printGoalDetail() shows the formatted output pattern.
Pattern for listing resources with formatting. Shows how to display tabular data with padEnd() alignment.
Simplest pattern for triggering an async server operation. POST to API, print result. The check trigger is similar but adds polling.
hxFetch() HTTP client with retries, auth headers, basePath configuration. All API calls use this. The polling loop will call hxFetch repeatedly to check status.
Flag parsing utilities: getFlag, hasFlag, requireFlag, isHelpRequested, getPositionalArgs. Used by all commands for argument parsing.
HxConfig type (apiKey, url, orgId) and requireConfig/loadConfig. Commands use configOrHelp() from index.ts.
Pattern for resolving a user-provided reference (ID, shortId, number) to an internal ID via API. A similar resolve-rule utility may be needed for rule-ref.
parseApiError() utility for extracting user-friendly error messages from API responses. Shared across goal commands.
Scripts: build (tsc), typecheck (tsc --noEmit), test (tsc && node --test dist/**/*.test.js). No lint script. Binary: hlx -> dist/index.js.

facts: No existing playbook commands exist in the CLI. No files matching 'playbook' or 'PLAYBOOK' found in src/.
CLI uses zero external dependencies (only @types/node and typescript as devDeps). All HTTP via native fetch in hxFetch().
Command pattern: index.ts dispatches to command group routers (e.g., goals/index.ts), which dispatch to individual command handlers (e.g., goals/get.ts).
hxFetch uses basePath '/api/inspect' by default but accepts basePath: '/api' override. Playbook endpoints will use basePath: '/api'.
Auth is via API key (hxi_* or Bearer token) set during 'hlx login'. Config stored locally.
No existing polling pattern found in the CLI. tickets/rerun.ts fires and forgets. The playbook check command needs to introduce polling (loop with delay, checking status endpoint).
Output formatting uses console.log with padEnd() for alignment, --json flag for machine-readable output, and abbreviated IDs (id.slice(0,8) + '...').
Test framework: Node.js built-in test runner. Tests compile to dist/ first (tsc), then run via 'node --test dist/**/*.test.js'.
No lint script defined in package.json. Only typecheck via 'tsc --noEmit'.
unknowns: How to resolve a rule-ref in the CLI. Existing resolve-ticket.ts resolves ticket refs via API. A similar mechanism is needed for rules but no rule-ref resolution endpoint exists on the server.
Polling interval and timeout for 'hlx playbook check'. No existing polling pattern to reference. Need to decide on reasonable defaults (e.g., 5s interval, 10min timeout).
Whether the server will return the check with nested result data or require a separate artifact fetch. This determines how the CLI displays the result.
